Messages.Author: Damnans
Messages.Body:
Storyline Rewards 2015

Official release: February 21, 2015
Legal for Tournament Play: March 23, 2015

Among the core concepts of Storyline events is having the players contribute to the narrative of the World of Darkness as well as to the design direction of future cards in V:TES. Over the past several years, we've had unfinished business with respect to realizing these narratives in game form. The following cards represent the participation and contributions that you, the players, have made in the Storyline events, as well as the subsequent playtesting and feedback. We are grateful to all of you, and we look forward to providing more opportunities for you to help steer the direction of V:TES!

As mentioned previously, we're still waiting for one piece of artwork to be delivered. As soon as the piece arrives, we'll update the Storyline Rewards .pdf file to include the card.

The Returned (2015)

Baba Yaga, The Iron Hag
Lord Tremere
Mithras
The Capuchin
Montano
The Dracon
Vlad Tepes

Budapest EC Storyline (2012)

Bulscu (Advanced)
New Blood

Battle Lines (2010)

Winterlich
Rise of the Fallen

Palma De Mallorca EC Storyline (2009)

Claudio Severino (Advanced)

DOWNLOADS
Crypt cards . Size: 16,1 MB  Crypt cards print sheet (file with multiple copies -from 1 to 9- of the same card per page). Size: 16,1 MB  Library cards. Size: 12,9 MB
PRINTING INSTRUCTIONS

Before printing out the PDF files, make sure that Page Scaling is set to "None".

www.vekn.net/official-expansion-sets

V:EKN Website Coordinator

Most clans have two in game clans, thus easier to create decent crypt with disciplines. 6 clans out of 13 don't. All independent ones, Tzimisce and Lasombra. Out of those, 4 are independent clans with clan cards that don't really care about sect. Which leave us just two clans that somewhat rely on sabbat toys, like the other sabbat clans that shouldn't exist in the game but exist (!bru, !nos, !mal, !tor, !tre, !gan, !ven) [it's really long discussion why they shouldn't exist as standalone clans, let's not derrail the thead any further].

Tzimisce have really solid G2-G3 grouping allowing strong midcap and highcap decks that use sabbat tech.

On the other hand, G2-G3 Lasombra have just good highcap crypt that use sabbat tech, and decent (dom-obt, pot-obt don't have any good grouping atm) G3-G4-G5 mid-cap group that can't use sabbat tech along with lasombra tech as it uses many non-sabbat or non-lasombra vampires (mainly kiasyds, oneado and badr).

To be fair, Lasombra isn't in bad state despite it lack of strong allies (abbysal Hunter is, eh, not very good), unique actions (drink the blood and political struggle are both underwhelming. Zaire isn't bad, isn't that useful either, san nicolas is wallpaper), unique reactions (have none). It have some decent masters (power structure is good, +1 stealth is average, path is path). But their disciplines alone make them the game, who need good action when you already have best (govern), who need reactions when you already have best (deflection), stealth is always good as an option (especially one with combat end), so are s:ce. Their latest combat additions aren't bad either, just as new sabbat toys for midcap decks (under siege, mainly). The only problem is, Lasombra don't have good POT-OBT crypt as g3-g4 grouping is abysmal. I had to use 7 cap with no special rules just to make the deck!.

But back to Storyline Rewards, new Lasombra is decent vampire n it's own, it's just the thing that G4-G5 grouping have 5 vampires out of 21 who aren't sabbat (Tzimisce have 5 out of 23) (wait a sec, why Tzimisce have more vampires in grouping than lasombra?).

EDIT: okay, my bad, Montano is G3. He is also the best vampire for baltimore purge deck, and work nice with old power vampires (mocanda and 9 cap archbishops._. how can 9 cap archbishops with no meaningful special be any good?).

Messages.Author: ICL
Messages.Body:
> Lech wrote:
> That camarilla clans got unfair advantage due to duplicate crypt options. Lasombra, Tzimisce and independent clans are disadvantaged due to that stupid design choice, and they didn't get any compensation for it.
>
Independents have gotten plenty of compensation - count up number of clan cards for them compared to other clans.

I agree that to make Lasombra and Tzimisce more interesting they should get something and an obvious something is a bunch of additional vampires, with the main splits being Sabbat and Laibon but with a few others. The problem with this is that people equate more options with more power, which, actually, does often end up being the case, and neither is hurting that bad powerwise. For a similar example, see how little enthusiasm there is for creating more Camarilla or Camarilla Clan cards, even though it's easy to make cards that don't help P/J decks or ICM decks.

On the other hand, saying that Tzimisce have a great 2/3 crypt is an awful argument. Those were cards largely printed about 15 years ago. Malks have a great group 1 crypt in that Aus/Dom/Obf is one of the best discipline combinations possible even if many of the specific vampires are limited and somewhat lacking. That's not an argument for avoiding printing any useful Malks. And, we've certainly seen lots of quality Malks in later groups.

Traveller Card Game

Messages.Author: ICL
Messages.Body:
**My comments

> Lech wrote:
> Compare amount of GOOD camarilla cards to GOOD sabbat cards, it's not even close.
>
> GOOD Cammy:
> -Alastor **Requires Justicar or ICM
> -Anathema **Requires P/J
> -Archon **Requires P/J
> -Accounting **Requires P/J
> -Domain **Requires P/J
> -Masquarade **Requires P/J
> -Judgment: Cammy Segregation **Requires P/J
> -Parity Shift **Requires P/J
> -Temptation of Greater Power **Requires Justicar
> -Progeny **Requires P/J
> -Justicars **Um ...
>
> Good Sabbat:
> -Abbot **Does not require a title
> -Black Forest Base **Does not require a title
> -Creation Rites **Requires Sabbat royalty
> -Under Siege **Requires a title
> -Yawp Court **Does not require a title
> -Cardinal Benediction **Does not require a title
> -Legacy of Pander **Only helps titleless Pander
>
> So what if sabbat have 77 sect card and cammy boytoys just 58, when power level of the former is few times worse than the latter ?
>
> Yes, there is reason to be rank-and-file sabbat as you benefit from Abbot, BFB, YC and US, but on the other hand benefit from being titled sabbat vampire is way worse than benefit from power titled cammy boy (Prince+, Primogens are just as shafted as rank-and-file).
>
Seems like you are making the argument for us that Camarilla needs something ... as I said ... that doesn't help P/J and ICM decks.

To beat a dead horse, being a Primogen is (on average) a detriment not a positive. The one attempt to do anything for them was a bust.

Creating cards with "Requires an untitled Camarilla vampire.", "Burn this card if you control a titled Camarilla vampire.", or whatever to make cards nonsynergistic with the good Camarilla effects is easy. Possibly not terribly thematic if overdone, but easy.

More variety is something everyone should receive, though obviously the weaker clans have an argument that they should get it to stop being so weak.

As I'm not attracted to power but rather to variety, I find the Cam clans the least appealing to play and have felt that way for many years.

But, anyway, more than one thing can be true at the same time. Lasombra and Tzimisce should get more because they are being treated as just more clans when they are something a lot more than that in the IP. Meanwhile, the original four Indies just have an absurd number of cards relative to these two Sabbat clans.

Traveller Card Game
